# Accessibility

freview aims to make repository assessments readable and usable in text-only terminals and assistive workflows. Its output should not rely on color, icons or animations to communicate a failure or decision; use clear headings, explicit status wording and machine-readable metadata where appropriate.

Because freview coordinates multiple agents and repositories, actual accessibility depends on the invoking agent, terminal, device and report renderer. We do not claim formal WCAG conformance or comprehensive assistive-technology testing at this time.

To report an accessibility problem, [open an issue](https://github.com/raiseCatError/freview/issues/new) with the agent/tool, terminal or browser, OS, assistive technology if relevant, reproducing prompt and any obstacles. Avoid including secrets or private code. Security-sensitive findings should use the confidential process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
